name: Conga tumbao + tambourine
desc: Uzu toms pitched up into a conga tumbao that drifts as a 5-sound polymeter against the 8th grid (realigns every 5 cycles), offbeat tambourine with dub delay, ghost shaker 16ths, rotating cowbell. Peak adds a vcsl bongo euclid that walks through 16 positions.

code.full: stack(s("[~ tb]*4").gain(${gain}*.6).hpf(800).room(.2).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).pan(.62), s("{mt lt ht lt lt}%8").speed(${spd}).gain("[.4 .25 .3 .25]*2").shape(.15).pan(sine.range(.3, .5).slow(16)), s("sh*16").gain("[.18 .07 .12 .06]*4").pan(cosine.range(.55, .7).slow(16)), s("cb(2,8,<0 3>)").gain(.18).pan(.35).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[~ tb]*4").gain(${gain}*.65).hpf(700).room(.2).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).pan(.62), s("{mt lt ht lt lt}%8").speed(${spd}).gain("[.45 .3 .35 .3]*2").shape(.2).pan(sine.range(.28, .52).slow(12)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("sh*16").gain("[.22 .09 .15 .08]*4").pan(cosine.range(.55, .72).slow(12)), s("bongo(5,16,<0 4 8 12>)").n("<0 1>").gain(.4).speed(1.1), s("cb(3,8,<0 3 6>)").gain(.2).pan(.35)).orbit(2).play()
